title: DFHCOMMAREA — CICS communication area, the per-transaction shared byte buffer between LINKed programs
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICS-CHILD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-LOCAL  PIC X(20).
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01  DFHCOMMAREA.
           05  CA-OP     PIC X.
           05  CA-INPUT  PIC X(40).
           05  CA-OUTPUT PIC X(40).
      *> The CICS transaction passes DFHCOMMAREA between programs.
      *> The structure is a CONVENTION between caller and callee --
      *> there is no compile-time check. Mismatched layouts cause
      *> silent byte-level corruption. A Java port to a typed DTO is
      *> safer but the spec must capture the exact byte layout.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           IF CA-OP = 'R' MOVE CA-INPUT TO CA-OUTPUT.
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
notes: DFHCOMMAREA is the COBOL-CICS analog of a function-call argument list — except it's a flat byte buffer with caller-defined layout. Migrating to a typed DTO needs the buffer layout enumerated AND every caller/callee verified.
